summary: PlacementHistory is a component of the HSPnet system managing the placement history for staff profiles. It involves user interaction to display, sort, and manage details of placement records, including reports and printing functions.
purpose: To manage and display placement history details associated with staff profiles.

workflows.name: Report Generation
steps: System checks user session and available data.
System fetches data and generates report.
Report is displayed if data is valid.

business_rules: Reports are generated only when user session is active.
validations: Ensure PRHistoryOnly flag is set appropriately.
calculations: SortExpression based on user input for report display.
system_behavior: Visibility controls based on data attributes.
exceptions: Report HTML display is conditional on valid user session.
